quotes.quote: However, training records had not been kept up to date.
Care records did not always reflect people’s care needs.
Care records were not always reviewed on a regular basis.
There were shortfalls in medicines records and care plans.
One person said, “I’m not aware of having a care plan”.
Care plans were incomplete or not followed in practice.
However, we saw that risk assessments were not comprehensive.
They did not maintain appropriate personnel records for staff.
In addition to this, medicines reviews were not always documented.
Audits and checks were not always effective in ensuring continuous improvement.
There were also inconsistencies in the recording and locations of certain documentation.
As a result, completed audits did not drive improvements.
Some care plans were not detailed enough to reflect the care being provided.
The residents' care plan was not always updated after changes being made to their plan of care.

failedRegulations.name: Reg 5 Individual assessment and care plan
